column1: # Ezhuthola's own extra Malayalam words (GPL-3.0, part of Ezhuthola).
# Common words the subtitle word list (FrequencyWords) is missing: places, festivals, everyday nouns.
# They give suffix splitting a real base: കേരളം -> കേരളത്തിൽ (keralathil).
# Format: word<TAB>count. The count is a modest made-up one, so real counts from the main list win.
# The app's own name, so it's spelled right from the first try (ezhuthola / ezhuththola)
# Food, apps and phone words people write in Malayalam (puttu, reels, insta).
# Words from real-world testing (Oct 31, 2026): checked by hand, standard spellings.
# Fish people talk about (Nov 15, 2026): typed by hand, usual written spellings.
# A few were in the main list but rare (അയല, ചെമ്മീൻ, സ്രാവ്); listing them here lifts them.
# Everyday chat words from a friend's list: missing or rare in the main list.
# Fruits (Nov 15, 2026): typed by hand, usual written spellings. Names written as one word
# the way they're usually written (കദളിപ്പഴം, ഞാലിപ്പൂവൻ). Rare ones in the main list are lifted.
# Food (Nov 15, 2026): sadhya dishes and everyday food, typed by hand, usual written spellings.
# Malayalam calendar (Nov 16, 2026): Kollavarsham and its months, missing or rare before.
